svg.title: C10 / VOYAGER LOCAL GROUP HALOS engineering mission profile
svg.desc: C10, VOYAGER LOCAL GROUP HALOS. Original project: MW-Andromeda Dark Matter Halo Velocity Dispersion Profiles. Session C: Astronomy & Space Physics. Scientific question: Which differences between Milky Way and M31 potential and dispersion profiles survive matched tracer selection, anisotropy uncertainty, and removal of tidal substructure? Testable hypothesis: Jointly modeling halo membership, tracer density, and anisotropy will broaden mass uncertainties but reduce spurious galaxy-to-galaxy differences caused by unmatched stellar populations.. svg.text: MW-Andromeda Dark Matter Halo Velocity Dispersion Profiles
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Infer the gravitational potentials of the Milky Way and Andromeda through
matched stellar-tracer models. Measured stellar velocity dispersions are not
direct measurements of dark-matter particle velocity dispersions. Use
tracer-density and anisotropy assumptions explicitly, separate equilibrium
halo stars from tidal debris, and then predict a dark-matter dispersion
profile only under an additional distribution-function or Jeans model.
Which differences between Milky Way and M31 potential and dispersion
profiles survive matched tracer selection, anisotropy uncertainty, and
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Jointly modeling halo membership, tracer density, and anisotropy will
broaden mass uncertainties but reduce spurious galaxy-to-galaxy differences
Spherical equilibrium is a baseline approximation and must be stress-tested
A dark-matter velocity prediction requires a separately specified density
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
The mass-anisotropy degeneracy, non-equilibrium streams, uncertain outer
tracer density, and Milky Way frame conversion can dominate. M31 projected
data and Milky Way 3D data provide unequal information.
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.
Bird et al. (2022), Milky Way stellar-halo
